title: Left tail asymptotics for the density of supercritical branching processes in random environment
summary: Let $(Z_n)_{n\geq 0}$ be a supercritical branching process in a random environment in which every individual produces at least one offspring, and let $W$ be the almost sure limit of the normalized $Z_n$. Write $p_1$ for the (random) probability that an individual has exactly one child and $m_0$ for the mean offspring number in a given environment. Assume that $p_1$ is positive almost surely and bounded away from $1$, that $m_0$ is bounded away from $1$ and from infinity together with a mild moment condition, and that $\log m_0$ is non-lattice.
